definition: The output witness has the same counterexample/obstruction status as the input under the operation map.
output_condition: output status represents the same counterexample
measure_requirement: no strict decrease required for status itself; operation may need measure for support reduction
proof_requirement: status preservation sublemma for the specific operation
allowed_use: use only when operation-specific preservation is proved
disallowed_use: do not infer from payload well-definedness alone
relation_to_limited_theorem: preserved support<=8 output may feed limited theorem after support bound
relation_to_support_bound: support-bound can use it only with valid measure or closure

definition: The operation produces a valid counterexample/obstruction witness with strictly smaller selected support measure.
output_condition: smaller witness carries preserved or reduced status
measure_requirement: strict support/canonical lexicographic measure decrease required
disallowed_use: do not call smaller witness without measure decrease
relation_to_limited_theorem: smaller support<=8 output may feed limited theorem

definition: The operation constructs a target contradiction that refutes the alleged counterexample branch.
input_condition: valid target object;theorem applies to same status branch
allowed_use: use for family-chain theorem contradiction branch
disallowed_use: do not treat as preserved witness
relation_to_limited_theorem: limited theorem unaffected unless target reaches support8 separately

definition: The bounded family-chain theorem absorbs the matched target object after payload/status alignment.
output_condition: target obstruction is absorbed or refuted
measure_requirement: no smaller-witness measure required unless residual witness is produced
proof_requirement: family-chain theorem applicability plus status alignment
disallowed_use: do not infer from lower-layer freshness alone
relation_to_support_bound: support-bound may close the branch conditionally
caveat: Absorption may be contradiction, not smaller witness.

definition: The case leaves current operation scope and is named as higher-support escape.
input_condition: no valid operation proof or bounded target closure
allowed_use: use only as named open residual
disallowed_use: do not present as proof completion
relation_to_limited_theorem: blocks broader theorem, not limited theorem
caveat: No support9+ scan is performed here.

definition: The operation applies syntactically but a specific preservation/measure/congruence sublemma is missing.
disallowed_use: do not hide as higher-support automatically
relation_to_limited_theorem: limited theorem unaffected until reduced support<=8 exists

definition: The operation precondition does not hold for the case.
proof_requirement: proof that precondition is absent or not selected
disallowed_use: do not treat as operation failure proof
relation_to_support_bound: case may move to another operation or escape
